predecessors.name: French Second Republic
predecessors.text: France, the whole outline, under the Empire proclaimed on 2 December 1852

successors.name: French Third Republic
successors.text: France, the Republic proclaimed on 4 September 1870

ledger.x: 2 December 1852: Napoleon III is proclaimed Emperor and the Second Empire replaces the Republic.

2 December 1852 (dossier boundary, continuing from July 1849): the French garrison in Rome stays under the Empire, opened at the Empire's proclamation so that it joins the Second Republic's occupation_end of 1852/12 without a gap.
September 1854: the Allies land in the Crimea.
30 March 1856: the Treaty of Paris ends the Crimean War.
1859: France goes to war with Austria in Italy.
1859: France is victorious.
24 March 1860: Sardinia cedes Savoy and Nice to France.
2 February 1861: the Prince of Monaco renounces Menton and Roquebrune to France.
7 January 1862: French troops land at Veracruz.
17 May 1863: Puebla surrenders to the French.
10 June 1863: the French occupy Mexico City.
12 November 1864: a French fleet arrives at Mazatlan.
29 March 1865: a French squadron lands at Guaymas.
September 1866: the French leave Guaymas.
13 November 1866: the French complete the evacuation of Mazatlan.
February 1867: the French evacuate Veracruz.
5 February 1867: the French leave Mexico City.
12 March 1867 (bridged): the last French troops embark.
1870: the French garrison leaves Rome.
4 August 1870: the first action of the war on French soil.
4 September 1870: the Empire falls; the war goes on under the Republic.
4 September 1870: the Second Empire ends and a republic is proclaimed in Paris.

wars.name: Crimean War
wars.outcome: The Allies took Sevastopol on 9 September 1855; the Treaty of Paris of 30 March 1856 ended the war and the Danubian principalities became largely independent Ottoman vassals.

wars.name: Second Italian War of Independence
wars.outcome: 'France was victorious and gained Savoy and Nice' (page); Lombardy passed from Austria to Sardinia, which ceded Savoy and Nice by the Treaty of Turin of 24 March 1860.

wars.name: Second French intervention in Mexico
wars.outcome: 'Mexican Republican victory' (infobox, 8 December 1861 - 21 June 1867): Maximilian's empire fell and the last French troops embarked on 12 March 1867.

wars.name: Franco-Prussian War
wars.outcome: The Empire fell on 4 September 1870 after Sedan; the Government of National Defence signed an armistice (26-28 January 1871) and the Treaty of Frankfurt on 10 May 1871, giving Germany 'most of Alsace and parts of Lorraine'.

certainty.note: Metropolitan France is drawn from treaty frontiers (the Savoy and Nice line of the Treaty of Turin, 24 March 1860).
